svg.title: House 03 — garden level circulation study
svg.desc: An original office drawing of the Mount Nicholson House 03 demo model. An ink floor plan shows the guest suite, furnished living and dining spaces, folding stair, kitchen, planted courtyard and angled pool. A vermilion line traces a route from the living room, through the glazed frontage and along the paved terrace to the pool. The inset studies the threshold in section. This is a schematic design interpretation, not a surveyed or construction drawing.
